label.purpose: Chips, legends, timestamps, card feet; mono, uppercase, 0.12em.

mark-compact-tablet.purpose: 22px Anton at the tablet masthead breakpoint.

mark-compact-phone.purpose: 19px Anton at the phone masthead breakpoint.

long-repo-title.purpose: Full detail-page repository name over 35 characters; responsive Anton display scale below a smaller mono owner attribution.

body-small.purpose: Person and contact lines, 15px Public Sans.

data.purpose: Key/value rows, 14px Plex Mono with tabular numerals.

note.purpose: Status row, legend, n-of-m, 12.5px Plex Mono.

shadows.name: card-hover
shadows.purpose: Card hover, combined with a -2px translate.

motion.name: stamp-press
motion.purpose: One-time page-arrival press for the refresh stamp; separate from the randomized overprint.

motion.name: stamp-overprint-plate
motion.value: 1350ms steps(1,end); second plate offset by 150ms; 1600ms burst; randomized 8–18s idle interval
motion.purpose: Cobalt and sunflower outline plates stutter through four registrations behind the stationary tomato stamp while it is visible; they do not imply a data refresh or alter the age. The sequence stops offscreen, in hidden tabs, and unless html[data-motion='on'].

motion.name: pulse-dot
motion.purpose: Collector status dot.

motion.name: rise-in
motion.purpose: Card entrance, staggered 45ms, first 12 only.

motion.name: stack-print
motion.purpose: The language stack fading up at full width; never drawn partially filled.

motion.name: panel-register-pass
motion.value: 3.6s linear infinite; second panel offset by -1.8s
motion.purpose: A heavy tomato rule repeatedly registers across each ledger panel's top ink edge without moving the figures.

motion.name: stack-registration-sweep
motion.purpose: An 8px near-white paper/ink scan source crosses the completed language distribution bar with difference blending, inverting against each underlying segment for a contrasting rendered line in either theme; all segment widths remain truthful, and the pass hides while the chart is inspected.

motion.name: cycle-progress
motion.value: 1s linear fill and index mark; 1.4s fixed-tile print stripe; 520ms tail catch + 420ms sheet exit + 520ms sheet entry at the hour boundary
motion.purpose: Shows elapsed-hour progress and live collector cadence; the stripe advances exactly one repeat tile per cycle and stops when motion is off. At the boundary the tail crosses the span the head reached, the sheet wipes out to the right, and the next sheet prints in from the left with the new hour's fill already seated.

motion.name: card-ledger-register
motion.value: 8s linear infinite; 1.4s initial delay + 150ms per rank
motion.purpose: A 5px cobalt stroke draws across each card's top rule over 480ms in commit-rank order; the badge press and arrow nudge remain on their original 8s cadence with 150ms rank offsets. Stored metrics stay still.

motion.name: card-corner-register
motion.value: 5.4s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1) infinite; independent phase every 600ms over nine bounded ranks
motion.purpose: Four tomato crop marks press and recoil on their own cadence and do not synchronize with or reset alongside the cobalt pass; marks stay behind the commit label and repository content remains still.

motion.name: card-index-tab
motion.purpose: A sunflower registration tab makes a short independent snap between ordered ledger passes; the modulo phase stays bounded as repositories are added.

motion.name: card-title-reprint
motion.value: 4.8s ease-in-out infinite; 240ms phase slots across 7 ranks
motion.purpose: The existing sunflower external-link underline briefly registers twice on an independent bounded cadence; the line stays visible, and the animation never changes repository text or data.
motion.reducedMotion: Stopped when html[data-motion='off']; existing hover/focus rule-draw takes precedence

motion.name: count-up
motion.purpose: Hero totals counting inside a box sized to the final value. Runs only when the figure moved since this document last showed it, and from that previous value to the new one — a returning navigation over unchanged figures must not replay the climb.

motion.name: cursor-link-step
motion.purpose: The drawn hand pointer rests 700ms then presses for 140ms, stepped frame by frame because an animated image cannot animate a cursor. Only the hovered control animates; motion off holds the resting frame.
motion.reducedMotion: Stopped when html[data-motion='off']; the resting frame remains

motion.name: cursor-wait-step
motion.purpose: Eight 125ms frames of the drawn wait ring while the pending veil blocks the page.
motion.reducedMotion: Stopped when html[data-motion='off']; the resting frame remains

motion.name: cursor-working-step
motion.purpose: The drawn progress pointer turns while older commits load, because that fetch is busy while the page itself stays usable.
motion.reducedMotion: Stopped when html[data-motion='off']; the resting frame remains

motion.name: card-hover
motion.purpose: Card lift and shadow colour change.

motion.name: rule-draw
motion.purpose: The card rule redraws on hover and focus-within.

motion.name: page-register
motion.purpose: Page arrival: the view transition on navigation, and <main> on a refresh. 300ms.

motion.name: page-lift
motion.purpose: Outgoing route; leaves faster than the arrival.

components.name: Repository Detail Heading
components.description: Short repository names retain the quiet inline owner prefix and large sunflower-highlighted name. Names over 35 characters move the owner to a smaller mono attribution line and set the full name below at a balanced, controlled display size; names are never truncated.

components.name: Ledger Registration Pass
components.description: A 5px cobalt top-edge stroke draws across each card over 480ms in commit-rank order. Four tomato corner marks press and recoil on their independent 5.4s loop with nine bounded phase slots; they do not synchronize with the cobalt stroke. The badge press and external-link arrow nudge keep their original 8s cadence. The commit label is z-index 4 above the stroke at 3 and marks at 2. An independent sunflower tab runs on a 3.2s loop over nine bounded phases; the title underline re-registers on a 4.8s loop over seven.

components.name: Repository Title Reprint
components.description: The existing sunflower external-link underline makes a brief double registration on its own 4.8s loop, phased independently over seven bounded slots. The line remains present; hover/focus redraw takes precedence; repository text and values never move.

components.name: Corner Registration Marks
components.description: Four inset tomato crop marks press and recoil on an independent 5.4s cadence, phased every 600ms across nine bounded slots. They never sync to the cobalt pass; they are non-semantic, behind the commit badge, and do not move card content.

components.name: Pointer
components.description: The system cursor is replaced by a 24px drawn set: arrow on <html>, stepped hand on links and controls, I-beam on prose, stepped wait ring on the pending veil, stepped progress arrow on the disabled commit button. Unused actions (grab, zoom, resize, help, copy, alias, context menu) ship no cursor. Hotspots come from each frame's alpha channel; motion off keeps the artwork and drops the stepping.

components.name: Repository Card
components.description: One public repository: the paper surface links internally to project details and recent commits. Only the highlighted title and its square-arrow mark link to GitHub; hovering that title alone highlights the external action. The two-line title rule tracks the final line without changing card height.

components.name: Cycle Gauge
components.description: Square Civic Poster progress gauge. Accessible fill and sunflower index mark follow true wall-clock hour progress with one-second readings; fixed tick marks and a paper track establish the printed-measure look. A narrow stripe pattern travels through cobalt fill by one exact 28px tile per 1.4s cycle, seamless because its start and end background positions are identical. At the hour boundary the tail crosses the span the head reached, the whole sheet wipes out to the right with the head leaving it, and the next sheet prints in from the left with the stripe already running; the new hour's fill is seated behind the wipe. The stripe stops when motion is off.

components.name: Branded Tooltip
components.description: A shared portal for pointer and keyboard help notes. Square paper on ink rules, a tomato registration edge, mono label, and hard offset shadow; never a browser-native title popup. Card language segments show their own share, while the whole bar track supplies a concise leading-share fallback so its border and gaps are not dead hover zones.

components.name: Theme Toggle
components.description: Cycles Auto, Light, Dark; writes data-theme and localStorage.

components.name: Refresh Stamp
components.description: The collection time, tilted like a pasted date slip. While visible, two registration plates stutter behind the still-readable tomato face at randomized intervals; the flourish does not imply or alter a refresh. Replaced a decorative tape strip.

components.name: Key/Value Panel
components.description: Mono rows separated by 2px rules, values right-aligned and tabular.

components.name: Filter Chip
components.description: Filters the index by leading language; count in brackets.

components.name: Motion Toggle
components.description: Cycles Motion: sys, on, off. Writes html[data-motion] plus data-motion-mode and persists the explicit choice to localStorage.motion; sys follows the OS setting.

components.name: Route Pending
components.description: Skeleton shown while a route loader fetches the index: status line, indeterminate rule, headline and card placeholders. Driven by router.state.isLoading.

narrative.overview: The site is a printed civic notice: a sheet of paper pasted on a bright board, with rules drawn by hand, blocks of flat colour where a number matters, and everything set in a condensed headline face that assumes you will read it from across the street. Structure is visible, colour is applied in blocks, and type does the hierarchy. The dark theme is the same notice printed on dark stock.
keyCharacteristics: Square corners, 2-3px ink rules, offset shadows with no blur radius.
Sunflower ground with paper panels; colour arrives in solid rectangles.
Anton for display, Public Sans for reading, IBM Plex Mono for data.
The refresh time is a stamp, not a subtitle.
Light and dark are the same system with the paper swapped.

rules.name: The Tooltip Surface Rule
rules.body: Supplemental hover/focus notes use one shared portal in the printed-notice palette, never browser-native title popups. They remain supplementary and are reachable by pointer and keyboard.

rules.name: The Stepped Cursor Rule
rules.body: An animated image cannot animate a cursor, so each animated cursor set is stepped frame by frame with a keyframed cursor value and steps(1, end). Hotspots are read from each frame's alpha channel rather than guessed.

rules.name: The Armed Cursor Rule
rules.body: The link cursor animates on hover only, restarting from its resting frame, so a press never begins mid-beat and an idle page carries no cursor animation. Motion off keeps the drawn cursors and removes the stepping.

rules.name: The Wall Clock Rule
rules.body: Every reading of the collector is a function of Date.now(), never of how long the tab has been open: the countdown and the gauge derive from the current UTC minute, so the hour turns over on screen. The interval pauses while the tab is hidden and recomputes on return.

rules.name: The Hourly Re-read Rule
rules.body: The index re-reads itself when its loaded rows belong to an hour that has ended: a handful of attempts just past the boundary, then nothing until the next hour. That refresh is background work, so it must not raise the Reading the index veil over a page the reader is already reading.

rules.name: The Held Masthead Rule
rules.body: The masthead is a named view-transition group, so a route change turns the sheet underneath it instead of fading the whole document out and back. Unnamed, a navigation looked like a full reload; the wordmark is now pixel-identical through the transition.

rules.name: The Steady Pointer Rule
rules.body: The pointer never changes shape because the page is mid-transition. A view transition makes the document root the hit target, so the shape is tracked on <html> and frozen while the transition runs, then re-read from the settled page.

rules.name: The Moved Figure Rule
rules.body: A number only animates when it changed. Replaying a count over figures the reader just read claims something happened, and a scrambling headline is the browser's own signal for a reload.

rules.name: The Two Papers Rule
rules.body: Panels are never white-on-white: they are paper on ground, so every block has an edge before a border is drawn.

rules.name: The On-Accent Rule
rules.body: Text on sunflower or tomato is always #12100e.

rules.name: The Numbers Rule
rules.body: Every comparable figure is set in IBM Plex Mono with tabular numerals.

rules.name: The No-Blur Rule
rules.body: If a shadow has a blur radius, it belongs to another design system.

rules.name: The Living Rule
rules.body: At least one element must be visibly changing, and it must report something true.

rules.name: The Printed Gauge Rule
rules.body: The cycle gauge uses transform: scaleX() rather than animated width, follows wall-clock elapsed time at one-second readings, and has a one-second linear transition independent of route entrance and exit.

rules.name: The Print-Run Rule
rules.body: An hour boundary is not a rewind and not an abrupt snap. The fill stays at the value the head actually reached while a paper tail crosses that span from the left; the head holds at the measured edge until the tail arrives. The whole printed sheet then wipes out to the right, the head leaves with it, and the next sheet prints in from the left with the stripe already running. The new hour's fill is painted while the sheet is hidden, with transitions off, so the head never crosses back across the track. A tab that was hidden through the boundary snaps to the new hour instead of pretending it watched the hour end.

rules.name: The Quiet Fallback Rule
rules.body: prefers-reduced-motion removes every animation; the counts land immediately and the information survives.

rules.name: The Fill Rule
rules.body: Entrance animations use animation-fill-mode backwards, never both. A forwards-filling animation keeps applying its final transform, and an active animation outranks a transition on the same property, which silently disables every hover transform on the element.

rules.name: The Motion Choice Rule
rules.body: Every animation gates on html[data-motion='on'], a resolved value written before first paint. It starts from prefers-reduced-motion and can be overridden by the Motion control, because the OS preference is a default and not the only voice.

rules.name: The One Rule Rule
rules.body: A decorative rule belongs to the container it separates, never to a run of text: container rules are the same length on every card, text underlines are not.

rules.name: The Footer Rule
rules.body: The document is a column at least one viewport tall, with main flex-grow: 1, so a short page puts the footer against the bottom of the window rather than against the content it follows.

rules.name: The Closed Proportion Rule
rules.body: A stacked bar reaches the right edge, always: rounded shares leave a percent unaccounted for, so the remainder is folded into Other before rendering, and tiny slices get a minimum width without inflating their percentage.

rules.name: The Counting Figure Rule
rules.body: A figure that animates must not change its own width: the settled string is reserved as hidden pseudo-content, so the digits change inside a fixed box and the line never rewraps.

rules.name: The Pre-Paint Rule
rules.body: Anything that changes the first frame is decided in the inline script before paint: theme class, data-motion, data-motion-mode and motion-ready. State that arrives after hydration is a visible restart.

rules.name: The Label Rule
rules.body: The server cannot know a stored preference, so it must not render one label: every toggle ships all its labels and an html[data-*-mode] attribute decides which is visible.

rules.name: The One Arrival Rule
rules.body: A page arrives the same way by navigation or reload: page-register carries the first 300ms on both paths, and every entrance starts on the same beat after it.

rules.name: The Honest Skeleton Rule
rules.body: A loading state describes a wait that is really happening: ruled placeholders and no invented content, a label naming the action, 200ms before showing and 400ms minimum on screen, and a single motion-gated indeterminate rule.

rules.name: The Loaded Content Rule
rules.body: Content that has already loaded never animates in again: reveals belong to the page's arrival, one beat on mount, never to a scroll event.

dos: Do keep the panel ground paper and the page ground; the contrast between them is the layout.
Do use on-accent on sunflower and tomato in both themes.
Do set every comparable figure in mono with tabular numerals.
Do state the refresh time; the data is up to an hour old.
Do keep every motion attached to a real fact: a timestamp, a countdown, a count.
Do pause the ticker on hover and focus.
donts: Don't add border-radius, blur, or gradient fills.
Don't put cream text on sunflower or tomato.
Don't introduce a decorative element that carries no information.
Don't truncate a number, a repository name, or a date.
Don't let the headline rely on a fixed width.
Don't repeat a number in the ticker, the hero and the table.
Don't animate anything that is not true.
Don't let a percentage row stop short of 100; group the remainder as Other.
